newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal Q3, Q4 earnings seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal Q3, Q4 earnings seen lower.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said it expected a shortfall in research and development revenue to affect its third and fourth quarter earnings.
The company, which plans to release its third-quarter results by November 11, said revenue from research and development that is funded by the government would not meet expectations for 1996.
The company said it would nevertheless continue with its research and development projects by funding them with its own working capital and look for other sources of funding.
Based in Waltham, Mass, Molten Metal Technology is an environmental technology company that commercializes pollution prevention and waste recycling methods.
